tagline: Five-mode saturation with tone shelves and oversampling
description: A saturation effect with five curves named after hardware (Tape, Tube, Transistor, Transformer, Diode), drive up to 10x, low and high shelves after the curve, dry/wet mix and optional 2x or 4x oversampling. Each mode is a static waveshaping formula, not a circuit model.

features.name: Five modes
features.description: Tape and Transistor are symmetric curves (odd harmonics); Tube, Transformer and Diode treat the two halves of the wave differently, which adds even harmonics

features.name: Drive
features.description: 0% to 100%, multiplying the input by 1x to 10x before the curve

features.name: Oversampling
features.description: Off, 2x or 4x, using JUCE's polyphase IIR half-band filters, to reduce aliasing

features.name: Tone shelves
features.description: Low shelf at 200 Hz and high shelf at 5 kHz, ±12 dB each, after the saturation

features.name: Harmonic display and meters
features.description: Bars for H1-H8 that illustrate the typical harmonic pattern of the mode, scaled by drive (not measured from the audio), plus input and output peak readouts

useCases: Gentle saturation - Tape mode with low drive (10-30%)
Even-harmonic colour - Tube or Transformer mode with medium drive
Harder clipping - Transistor mode with high drive
Less aliasing at high drive - switch on 2x or 4x oversampling
learningFocus: Waveshaping curves named after analog hardware
Shelf filter design for tone shaping

algorithms.name: Tape
algorithms.description: Symmetric soft compression of the level, so it adds odd harmonics

algorithms.name: Tube
algorithms.description: Asymmetric tanh: the positive half saturates harder than the negative

algorithms.name: Transistor
algorithms.description: Linear up to 0.7, then a tanh knee toward 1.0 on both sides

algorithms.name: Transformer
algorithms.description: A gentle cubic term with slightly different gain on each half, then tanh

algorithms.name: Diode
algorithms.description: Clips the positive half from 0.3 upward; the negative half stays linear down to -2

algorithms.name: Oversampling
algorithms.description: Runs the curve and shelves at 2x or 4x the sample rate
